api_source.candidate_source_note: Hashes refer to the checked-out sources; the built candidate writer.py used the same logic before Ruff reformatted a cursor call.

environment: Apple M4 Max, Colima 0.9.1 (VZ Linux arm64, 6 vCPU, 8 GiB), Docker Compose 5.7.0; one Uvicorn worker; local plain HTTP/1.1 without compression; one host Python 3.13.14 client process per scenario.

fixture.fixture: deterministic JSONB via SQL generate_series (synthetic receipt)

method.http_and_database: Same 9M committed rows and PostgreSQL volume, fresh API per group, no manual cache flush. All bodies streamed with row-order, size and SHA-256 checks.
method.variants: Legacy decoder and current decoder use the same API (prefetch 8); candidate uses the current decoder with stream prefetch 32. Page prefetch is unchanged.
method.cpu: Server CPU uses cgroup cpu.stat deltas (user, system and throttle); client uses process CPU time. Average cores divide CPU seconds by group wall time.
method.network: PostgreSQL TCP counters are namespace-wide deltas. HTTP cadence observes transport chunks, not packets or server writes. Instrumentation adds small per-chunk overhead; null indicates it was not collected.
method.context_switches: API PID 1 and sampled aggregate of PostgreSQL application backends. PostgreSQL last full-pool sample minus first sample; approximate counts and null when not sampled.
method.cursor_execute_count_estimate: Uses floor(rows/prefetch)+1 per stream because an exact multiple requires a final empty execute to detect completion.
method.comparison: Per-variant medians of completed runs. Legacy serves as a decoder control; it has one group at two readers and two groups at four readers.
